description: DBA competency scorecard: fleet KPIs across Performance, Backup/DR, Availability/HA, and Security. Per-server rollup, composite issue score, and top exception tables. Deep dive: collector dashboards per pillar.

panels.description: Currently failed backup job last runs for real backup jobs.

panels.title: Missing Full Backup

targets.expr: count(((mssql_alwayson_group_synchronization_health{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance"} < 2) and on(instance, availability_group_name) (mssql_alwayson_replica_role{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", role_desc="PRIMARY"} == 1))) or vector(0)

panels.description: Max secondary lag on PRIMARY view.

targets.expr: max(((mssql_alwayson_secondary_lag_seconds{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance"}) and on(instance, availability_group_name) (mssql_alwayson_replica_role{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", role_desc="PRIMARY"} == 1))) or vector(0)

panels.title: Backup Transfer

targets.expr: count(((mssql_alwayson_group_synchronization_health{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance"} < 2) and on(instance, availability_group_name) (mssql_alwayson_replica_role{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", role_desc="PRIMARY"} == 1))) or vector(0)

count(((mssql_alwayson_replica_connected_state{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance"} == 0) and on(instance, availability_group_name) (mssql_alwayson_replica_role{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", role_desc="PRIMARY"} == 1))) or vector(0)

sum(((mssql_alwayson_is_suspended{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance"} == 1) and on(instance, availability_group_name) (mssql_alwayson_replica_role{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", role_desc="PRIMARY"} == 1))) or vector(0)

count(((mssql_alwayson_is_failover_ready{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance"} == 0) and on(instance, availability_group_name) (mssql_alwayson_replica_role{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", role_desc="PRIMARY"} == 1))) or vector(0)

count(mssql_replication_distribution_agent_status{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", status_desc=~"fail|retry"}) + count(mssql_replication_logreader_agent_status{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", status_desc=~"fail|retry"}) or vector(0)
count(count by (instance, cluster_name) (mssql_hadr_cluster_quorum_state{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance"} != 1)) or vector(0)

sum((((mssql_alwayson_sync_state_flaps_24h{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance"}) and on(instance, availability_group_name) (mssql_alwayson_replica_role{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", role_desc="PRIMARY"} == 1)) >= 0)) or vector(0)

panels.description: Weighted rollup per server across performance, backup, HA, and security signals. Higher = more issues.

targets.expr: (count by (instance) (mssql_backup_age_seconds{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", backup_type="full"} < 0) or (count by (instance) (mssql_up{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance"}) * 0))

(count by (instance) (((mssql_alwayson_group_synchronization_health{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance"} < 2) and on(instance, availability_group_name) (mssql_alwayson_replica_role{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", role_desc="PRIMARY"} == 1))) or (count by (instance) (mssql_up{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance"}) * 0))

panels.title: Per-Server DBA Rollup

panels.description: Composite DBA issue score (higher = worse). Top 15 servers.

targets.expr:
topk(15,
  (
    (sum by (instance) (mssql_blocking_count{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance"}) or (count by (instance) (mssql_up{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance"}) * 0))
    + (max by (instance) (mssql_waits_nonbenign_percent{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance"}) or (count by (instance) (mssql_up{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance"}) * 0)) / 20
    + (sum by (instance) (mssql_backup_job_failed_total_24h{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance"}) or (count by (instance) (mssql_up{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance"}) * 0)) * 5
    + (count by (instance) (mssql_backup_age_seconds{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", backup_type="full"} < 0) or (count by (instance) (mssql_up{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance"}) * 0)) * 3
    + (count by (instance) (((mssql_alwayson_group_synchronization_health{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance"} < 2) and on(instance, availability_group_name) (mssql_alwayson_replica_role{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", role_desc="PRIMARY"} == 1))) or (count by (instance) (mssql_up{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance"}) * 0)) * 5
    + ((sum by (instance) (mssql_failed_logins_total{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance"}) / 10) or (count by (instance) (mssql_up{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance"}) * 0))
    + (sum by (instance) (mssql_privileged_sessions{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance"}) or (count by (instance) (mssql_up{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance"}) * 0))
    + (max by (instance) (mssql_sa_login_enabled{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance"}) or (count by (instance) (mssql_up{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance"}) * 0))
  )
)

panels.title: DBA Issue Score - Top 15

targets.expr: topk(15, max by (instance, db) (mssql_backup_age_seconds{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", backup_type="full"} >= 0))

topk(15, label_replace(max by (instance, availability_group_name, db) (last_over_time(mssql_alwayson_secondary_lag_seconds{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance"}[5m])), "server", "$1", "instance", "(.+)"))

topk(15, (sum by (instance) (mssql_failed_logins_total{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance"}) / 10) + (sum by (instance) (mssql_privileged_sessions{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance"})) + (max by (instance) (mssql_sa_login_enabled{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance"})))
